Cold/L1/L2 launch a fresh process per retained sample; CPU backup and exact disk use repeated same-process cycles
comparability.prohibited_claim: Do not infer a strictly fair release-matched ranking or generalize beyond this local mechanism observation.

evidence_label: descriptive local mechanism comparison; not a release-matched system ranking
metric_boundary: Activation begins immediately before process start or wake API call and ends when the health/wake response returns; request generation is excluded.

phase_semantics.CPU\u2192GPU copy: Synchronous pinned CPU backup to GPU copy.
phase_semantics.Checkpoint load: vLLM L2 reload_weights HTTP step; includes layerwise checkpoint iteration/load.
phase_semantics.Control overhead: Residual required to reconcile disjoint phase times to the measured total.
phase_semantics.Disk read + hash + H2D pipeline: Exact-disk overlapped pipeline wall time; read, hash, and H2D overlap and therefore are not stacked separately.
phase_semantics.KV-cache remap: vLLM L2 wake of the KV-cache tag.
phase_semantics.Process + engine startup: Cold process creation through API health readiness; internal startup is not fully instrumented.

stability_rule.center: median of the five retained total-latency samples
stability_rule.profile: Use the phases from the retained real sample whose total is closest to the median; ties break by sample_index. Add Control overhead = measured total - disjoint accounted phases.
stability_rule.spread: minimum and maximum of the five retained total-latency samples
stability_rule.warmup: Discard sample/cycle index 0 for every method. Cold load and stock vLLM launch fresh processes per sample; CPU backup and exact disk use repeated same-process cycles.
